original_title: Taylor Swift: The 1989 World Tour - Live
overview: Filmed in front of 76,000 fans at the ANZ Stadium in Sydney, Australia, "The 1989 World Tour Live" captures Taylor Swift's entire performance while also mixing in behind-the-scene, rehearsal, and special guest footage from her 1989 Tour.
tagline: She lost him, but she found herself. And somehow that was everything.
